final_topology.title: Government Isolated Network
final_topology.description: A network for government operations with isolated sensitive systems and secure administration workstations.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network will consist of separate zones for standard and sensitive information, with dedicated management workstations and a secure internet gateway for the standard environment.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management' zone with an 'Asset Management System' node (n_new1) that is connected to various nodes across different zones, indicating the presence of an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Documentation' zone with a 'Data Flow Documentation System' node (n_new2) that is connected to various nodes across different zones, indicating the presence of data flow documentation.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1), 'Sensitive Environment' (z2), and 'Non-Production Environment' (z4), indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Server Firewall' node (n_new3) connected to the DNS server (n9), indicating the presence of a firewall on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server (n9) connected to the standard router (n6), indicating the presence of a trusted DNS server.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Service' node (n_new4) connected to the management switch (n8), indicating the presence of MFA for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' node (n_new5) connected to the DNS server (n9), indicating the presence of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'URL Filtering Service' node (n_new6) connected to the DNS server (n9), indicating the presence of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and nodes that are properly segmented and connected, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Workstations' zone (z3) with admin workstations (n4, n5) and a management switch (n8), indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' node (n13) connected to the standard router (n6), indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Service' node (n_new7) connected to the management switch (n8) and the AAA server (n13), indicating the presence of a VPN service integrated with AAA.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Workstations' zone (z3) with dedicated admin workstations (n4, n5) and a management switch (n8), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS' node (n11) connected to the standard router (n6), indicating the presence of a network intrusion detection system.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n19) and routers (n6, n7, n18) that are connected between different zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control System' node (n_new8) connected to the management switch (n8), indicating the presence of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Logging Service' node (n_new9) connected to various nodes across different zones, indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIPS' node (n12) connected to the standard router (n6), indicating the presence of a network intrusion prevention system.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' node (n16) connected to the standard router (n6), indicating the presence of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' node (n17) connected to the standard router (n6), indicating the presence of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1) and 'Non-Production Environment' (z4), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pentest Workstation' node (n20) connected to the non-production firewall (n19), indicating the presence of a penetration testing service.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.
